content.hebrew: אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ, יוֹשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֹת בְּנֵי אֵיתָן,
content.transliteration: Atta ḳadosh, yoshev tehillot benē etan,
content.english: You are holy, enthroned on the praises of the children of Ethan,
[You] who refine the souls of those who fear You, and [smooth] their path, their way.

content.hebrew: רָאֽוּךָ מַּֽיִם, יָחִֽילוּ; רִצַּֽצְתָּ רָאשֵׁי לִוְיָתָן.
content.transliteration: Ra’ukha mayim, yaḥilu; rits’tsatsta rashē livyatan.
content.english: Waters see You, and tremble; You have crushed Leviathan’s heads.
You gave teachings, specifying their laws, through the hands of the meek one.
He presented His chosen ones with a blessing and a curse:

content.hebrew: אִם יִשְׁמְעוּ, יִהְיוּ כְּמֹצֵא אֶחָיו בְּדֹתָן;
content.english: If they listen, they will be like the one who found his brothers in Dothan;
But if they fail to do so, they will be like Abiram and Dathan.
On Mount Gerizim are the blessings, and their testimony,

content.hebrew: וְעַל הַר עֵיבָל קְלָלוֹת עִם תְּעוּדָתָן.
content.english: And on Mount Ebal are the curses, with their attestation.
Happy are the people who choose to keep uprightness in their sight;
They have abandoned She’ol, through the fitness of their path,
And they have written her their writ of divorce.
Instead of their rebellion is their repentance.
Their scent is like a spice bed, like a palace garden.
Now, Your communities, in their songs of praise,
Beg for their redemption, out of their exile.

content.hebrew: קהל: בְּמִשְׁכְּנֵי עֶלְיוֹן תִּדְרְשׁוּ תָּמִיד פְּדוּתָן.
content.english: Cong. In the dwellings of the Holy One, you constantly seek their deliverance.
content.comments: You. The worshipers in the synagogue.

content.hebrew: חזן: פְּד֤וּת ׀ שָׁ֘לַ֤ח לְעַמּ֗וֹ צִוּה לְעוֹלָ֥ם בְּרִית֑וֹ קָד֖וֹשׁ וְנוֹרָ֣א שְׁמֽוֹ:
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Pedut, shalaḥ le‘ammo tsivva le‘olam berito ḳadosh venora shemo:
content.english: Cantor. He sent deliverance to His people; He commanded His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name! (Ps. 111:9)

content.hebrew: צַֽהֲלִ֥י וָרֹ֖נִּי יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צִיּ֑וֹן כִּֽי־גָד֥וֹל בְּקִרְבֵּ֖ךְ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
content.transliteration: Tsahali varonni yoshevet tsiyyon ki ḡadol beḳirbekh ḳedosh Yisra’el:
content.english: Rejoice and sing out, dweller of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great in Your midst! (Isa. 12:6)

content.hebrew: קהל: גֹּֽאֲלֵ֕נוּ יו֥י צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ קְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל:
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Go’alenu Adonai tseva’ot shemo ḳedosh Yisra’el:
content.english: Cong. Our redeemer, Adonai Ẓeva’oth is His name, the Holy One of Israel. (Isa. 47:4)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “the Lord of Hosts.”
